accent.use: Focus, the selected tab, keys and links in prose

waiting.use: ◆ waiting on you, anything that needs attention

review.use: In review, waiting on someone else; the Claude Code driver

link.use: Links you can open; the Codex driver

conversation.use: The row of the agent whose conversation has focus (background)

track.use: The empty part of a meter (background)

unread.use: Submitted reply not yet opened by the current actor (glyph only)

keycap-selected.use: Keyboard shortcut inside the selected control (background)

code.use: Inline code and code blocks in rendered Markdown (foreground only)

marks.◌: bound to a pane, no agent running
marks.◐: in review, waiting on someone else (board only)
marks.↻: leads a resume action, never a row's state
marks.‹ ›: tabs off the end of a line (board only)
marks.▸: a folded Squad board pane (board only)
marks.▾: an open foldable pane in a toggle hint (board only)
marks.≠: differs from all boards (this squad overrides it; board only)
marks.~: approximate observed token total from incomplete coverage (board only)
marks.≈: estimate marker before a list-price quote (board only)
marks.▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█: completed-request trend: ▁ measured zero, ▂–█ relative totals, blank no data (board only)
marks.×: remove a pasted-text attachment (board only; ASCII: x)
marks.≡: a conversation's Notes list and its summary chip (board only; the word Notes names it, so no ASCII form)
marks.↗: a Notes link row, which opens its reference (board only; ASCII: >)
